name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.5 degrees north of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 16 times in 5 visits over 29 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 30 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 29 hours starting 2025-11-08, at wavelengths from 0.74 to 3.73 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
